title: Orionid meteor shower observed in China's Heilongjiang
excerpt: This photo taken on Oct. 22, 2026 shows the Orionid meteor shower in the sky over Zhaodong City, northeast China's Heilongjiang Province. The Orionid meteor shower, caused by remnants from Halley's comet, peaked on Wednesday and Thursday.

Orionid meteor shower observed in China's Heilongjiang

This stack composite photo taken on Oct. 22, 2026 shows the Orionid meteor shower in the sky over Qiqihar City, northeast China's Heilongjiang Province. The Orionid meteor shower, caused by remnants from Halley's comet, peaked on Wednesday and Thursday. Photo: Xinhua
